title: Expired and Cancelled Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Plans
content:
An expired or cancelled Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan cannot unlock vehicles. Charges booked under it before it ended remain payable, and remain refundable under the Wayfare Bikes and Scooters refund rules. A rider whose plan expired buys a new plan rather than reactivating the old one.

## In brief

| Plan status | Can unlock vehicles | Charges booked before the plan ended | Way back to riding on a plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| expired | no | remain payable and refundable | a new plan is bought; the expired plan is not reactivated |
| cancelled | no | remain payable and refundable | — |

## Desk reference questions

**Does the end of a plan clear what was charged under it?**
No. Charges booked before the plan expired or was cancelled remain payable, and remain refundable under the refund rules of Wayfare Bikes and Scooters.

**Can an expired plan be switched back on?**
No. A rider whose Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan expired buys a new plan rather than reactivating the old one.

**Hypothetical case.** A rider's Wayfare Bikes Annual plan expired at the end of its term with an overtime fee from its last week still unpaid. The plan cannot unlock vehicles; the overtime fee remains payable and remains refundable under the refund rules; to ride on a plan again the rider buys a new one.
